strategy.rationale: Hybrid. (1) 82% of gameplay (1761/2149) sits in ONE connected component, so function-by-function (A) is infeasible in isolation: any one of those fns touches shared state roots; and only 172/2149 (8.0%) have decomp files, so no per-function oracle exists for the other 92%. (2) The dependency-first (C) axis is real and mandatory: top gl_fan_in roots (00b3d300 fan-in 252, 00b3d2a0 101, 00b5b800 80...) are almost all UNNAMED FUN_* with NO decomp - they gate the whole core and must be RE'd first. (3) Subsystem (B) axis is the only axis with decomp coverage: decomp exists only for SDK-named fns and they cluster (sim-cell cCellGFX/*, editor-core cEditor/*, sporepedia-online) into 24 DEPENDENCY_FIRST + 35 READY/READY_WITH_LOCAL_CONTEXT queue fns that form coherent units. (4) 330 isolated singletons (incl. 55 with decomp) are genuinely independent work packages. Hence D: subsystem-first on the decomp-covered clusters, dependency-first on the shared-state roots (RE them before their dependents), isolated singletons as parallel independent units, and skip the 185 LIKELY_INFRASTRUCTURE + 23 ENGINE_BOUNDARY fns entirely.
